# Implement Project Documentation

## Objectives

### Estimate project cost

- Use the [AWS Pricing Calculator](https://calculator.aws) to estimate
  infrastructure costs.
- Document the main AWS services/resources and their estimated monthly cost.
- Add the cost breakdown to the project presentation.

### Create stage journal & report

- Document the different project stages and milestones.
- Record completed work, challenges, solutions, and important decisions.
- Take relevant screenshots for each major project stage.
- Prepare a structured final project report.

### Create project presentation

- Build the project presentation using [Canvas](https://canva.link/f81xhuxb7tpsusi).
- Present the project objective, architecture, key features, security/IAM
  monitoring capabilities, implementation, and results.
- Include the AWS cost estimation.
- Keep the presentation concise and suitable for a project/demo presentation.

## Scoop

- AWS cost estimation and breakdown.
- Stage journal and final project report.
- Final project presentation.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AWS infrastructure costs are estimated and documented.
- [ ] Project development stages are documented in the journal/report.
- [ ] A complete project presentation is prepared.
- [ ] The presentation includes the project overview, architecture,
      implementation, results, and cost estimation.
